source: Build a 3D treasure hunt where my avatar explores a flooded temple,\ncrosses a dangerous route, collects three relics, and reaches an exit.\nMake the objective and first route obvious and recover me quickly if I fall.

image_prompt.text: Hidden cutouts behind collapsed masonry and overgrowth in the temple, rewarding players who poke around off the main route
An unmistakable first route out of the start area — raised walkways and stepping stones over the flooded floor, readable at a glance
The dangerous crossing: deep flooded sections, gaps and slick ledges that punish careless traversal
A pillar or carved board near the entrance stating the objective — three relics, then the exit
Flooded chambers with standing water and submerged ruins throughout the temple
A clearly visible exit at the far end of the temple, framed so it reads as the goal from a distance

layout_placement.text: Three relics on pedestals in separate parts of the temple
Frequent recovery points along the route so a fall returns the player to solid ground immediately rather than restarting
Objective state tracking which of the three relics have been taken
The completion trigger at the exit, which fires only once all three relics are held

notes: Shape was a close call: the prompt says explore, which suggests an open temple, but it also describes an ordered sequence — route, then relics, then exit — which is a guided corridor. Open was chosen because three relics in separate places implies branching.
The temple is an interior throughout. No outside-to-inside transition was stated, so no P3 was added; if the player starts outdoors and enters, that changes.
Two of the prompt's asks are qualities rather than objects: the objective must be obvious, and recovery must be fast. The first has no home at all; the second was read as dense checkpointing.

open_questions.ask: How long should the run take end to end — a couple of minutes, or a proper expedition?
Can the player wander the temple freely, or should the route be one directed path they cannot backtrack?
Does taking all three relics unlock the exit, or can the player leave early with fewer?

coverage_missing.ask: Free exploration of the temple, or one directed route?
How long should the run take end to end?
Does the exit stay locked until all three relics are held?

answers.ask: How long should the run take end to end — a couple of minutes, or a proper expedition?
answers.answer: A couple of minutes end to end; keep this as a compact, plainly playable treasure-hunt run.

answers.ask: Can the player wander the temple freely, or should the route be one directed path they cannot backtrack?
answers.answer: Use one clear directed path through the temple, with simple forward progression and no need to backtrack.

answers.ask: Does taking all three relics unlock the exit, or can the player leave early with fewer?
answers.answer: Collecting all three relics unlocks the exit; the objective is to retrieve them all and then escape.
